answers.how: The wallet’s longer edge is about 99 px. Its falling motion gives an acceleration of about 4650 px/s², so its length is 99 × 9.8/4650 × 100 cm.
The shorter edge is about 63 px. Using the gravity-derived scale, its length is 63 × 9.8/4650 × 100 cm.
A quadratic fit to the wallet’s positions gives a speed of about 1395 px/s at 2.50 s. Multiplying by 9.8/4650 converts this to m/s.
At 2.50 s, the bottom corner is approximately 366 px from the floor. Multiplying by the gravity-derived scale, 9.8/4650 m/px, gives the distance.
The wallet moves approximately 207 px between 2.20 s and 2.50 s. Its displacement is 207 × 9.8/4650 m.
The fitted falling motion gives a speed of about 1860 px/s at 2.60 s. Multiplying by 9.8/4650 converts this to m/s.
